findings.explanation: Rin’s admission that Caster and Kuzuki have outmaneuvered them becomes a generic expletive.

findings.highlight: Since we attacked them, Kuzuki will now stay
findings.evidenceJa: こうなった以上、葛木は柳洞寺から出てこない
findings.governingReading: Now that matters have come to this, Kuzuki will not leave Ryuudou Temple
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents their attack as the sole causal reason for Kuzuki’s retreat, where Rin’s conclusion concerns the whole changed situation.
Assassin’s established defensive role becomes the nonidiomatic “gate watcher.”

findings.highlight: we have to go to the Ryuudou Temple
findings.evidenceJa: こちらから柳洞寺に乗り込まなければ
findings.governingReading: we now have to storm Ryuudou Temple ourselves
findings.explanation: The need to enter enemy territory aggressively is weakened to mere travel to the temple.

findings.highlight: drag your Master into going there
findings.evidenceJa: 強攻策になんか巻き込まない
findings.governingReading: drag your Master into a forceful assault
findings.explanation: Rin promises not to involve Shirou in a high-risk direct assault, not simply not to take him to the temple.

findings.evidenceJa: “そうなのですかシロウ”と言わんばかりの顔つき
findings.governingReading: a look that all but says, “Is that so, Shirou?”
findings.explanation: Saber’s characteristic wording and direct address to Shirou are replaced by an abstract paraphrase.

findings.highlight: let us take his Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪を消させてくれる
findings.governingReading: allow us to erase his Command Spells
findings.explanation: Removing Kuzuki’s plural Command Spells and Master status becomes taking one spell as an acquired object.

findings.evidenceJa: 敵を見据えるような真剣さ
findings.governingReading: with the intensity of someone staring down an enemy
findings.explanation: Rin’s questioning gaze is serious specifically like confrontation with an enemy; the comparison disappears.

findings.highlight: I do it quite often to get myself together
findings.evidenceJa: 仕切り直すためによくやってた
findings.governingReading: I often did it to reset and start the training over
findings.explanation: Projection’s role in resetting a failed exercise becomes a way for Shirou to regain emotional composure.

findings.highlight: I can never manage to do it
findings.governingReading: I tried to account for the interior properly, but it did not work
findings.explanation: A description of prior failed projections becomes a categorical present-tense inability.

findings.highlight: My father told me it was useless
findings.evidenceJa: 切嗣はそれじゃ何の役にもたたないから
findings.governingReading: Kiritsugu said that would be of no use
findings.explanation: The explicit Kiritsugu referent, written under Shirou’s “old man/dad” reading, is reduced to a generic father and the layered relationship disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: ある事柄に関してのみ優れた魔術師
findings.governingReading: a magus who excels only in one particular field
findings.explanation: Technical specialization becomes raw power, changing Rin’s diagnostic hypothesis about Shirou’s aptitude.

findings.highlight: She does not even look at me
findings.evidenceJa: 俺と顔を合わそうとはせず
findings.governingReading: she makes no attempt to meet my eyes
findings.explanation: Rin’s active refusal to meet Shirou’s gaze becomes simple absence of looking.

findings.evidenceJa: 一人で帰路についてしまった
findings.governingReading: she sets off down the road home on her own
findings.explanation: Rin’s abrupt solitary departure and the visible beginning of the return journey become a generic completed trip home.
